rationale: C19 plausibly supplied a material drafting template for the child's central administrative machinery. Both directives place the Chairman of the National Security Resources Board above distributed agency programs and give him a closely parallel sequence of functions: prescribe policy or program directives, resolve or coordinate interagency matters, obtain agency reports and information, and advise or report to the President. The child substantially expands and adapts that machinery to physical security of important facilities. C23 is the next-strongest because it addresses protective planning against hostile attack, assigns planning duties across agencies, requires coordination involving the same Chairman, and authorizes advisory bodies, but its operational scheme is narrower and less closely matched. C11 has similar centralized direction, agency reporting, and presidential reporting provisions, but these are less distinctive and less extensive than C19's parallels.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Chairman shall supervise and bring into harmonious action the programs and measures referred to in section 2 of this order
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Chairman of the National Security Resources Board shall, in the interest of assisting the President to coordinate the functions delegated by this Executive order
shared_material.explanation: Both make the NSRB Chairman the central coordinator of programs carried out by multiple agencies.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Prescribe policies and programs governing the activities of Federal agencies with respect to the physical security of facilities
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Prescribe policy and program directives having the approval of the President.
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C19's policy-and-program directive authority to facility security.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Obtain from Federal agencies reports, recommendations, and information deemed by the Chairman to be essential
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Obtain reports and information on the status of work in the various agencies designated in this Executive order.
shared_material.explanation: This is a close functional and linguistic parallel in the Chairman's information-gathering authority.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Consult with Federal agencies having responsibilities related to functions set forth in this order, for the purpose of furthering coordination of policies and activities
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Take such measures to obtain coordination of related policies and activities among the various agencies as he may determine.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely carries forward C19's interagency policy-and-activity coordination mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Keep the President informed as may be necessary concerning the matters encompassed by this order and furnish him such recommendations as may be appropriate.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Advise the President on the progress of the defense production program and make such recommendations as he may deem proper.
shared_material.explanation: Both close the Chairman's enumerated responsibilities with presidential reporting and recommendations.
